file_type: PE32+ (x86-64) console executable, MinGW-w64 / GCC 13 built, symbols stripped (external PDB reference)

encryption_details.algorithm: RC4 (standard 256-byte KSA at 0x140001480 + PRGA/XOR at 0x140001573; state struct holds S[256] plus i at +0x100 and j at +0x104)
encryption_details.key_storage: Hard-coded 16-byte ASCII string in .rdata at VA 0x140004000, passed with length 0x10 to the KSA; the 64-byte ciphertext payload is stored in .data at VA 0x140003000 (c97e13a845df326c910e75b328fa4d8117a3d568f02b9e44cc59e73f8a16b15d22946fdb087caa31e54f891cd265f83b9d1076c057ea24b84c811ea933dd6bf5) and is copied to the stack and decrypted in place before execution

anti_analysis: User-mode API hook / EDR detection: function at 0x1400017F0 fetches the ntdll stub for NtAllocateVirtualMemory and validates the classic prologue bytes 4C 8B D1 B8 (mov r10,rcx; mov eax,SSN); a patched (hooked) stub is detected and aborts the flow

Hell's Gate style syscall number harvesting from ntdll export stubs (0x1400016A9) instead of calling the documented APIs, defeating IAT/API-based monitoring; includes a fallback scan of the first 32 bytes for a 'mov eax, imm32' (B8 xx xx 00 00) pattern to recover the SSN from hooked/jmp-patched stubs
No static imports of any ntdll/Nt* function - all native API metadata resolved at runtime via GetModuleHandleA + GetProcAddress (manual resolution hides intent from import-table triage)
Payload stored only as RC4 ciphertext in .data so no shellcode bytes / strings are visible to static scanners
Timing/execution delays: WaitForSingleObject with 5000 ms timeout on the payload thread and a Sleep(1000) before exit (sandbox timeout evasion)
Binary is compiled stripped (no symbols, external PDB reference) hampering static analysis

injection_details.method: Local/self shellcode injection: VirtualAlloc(NULL, size, MEM_COMMIT|MEM_RESERVE=0x3000, PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE=0x40) -> memcpy of the RC4-decrypted payload -> CreateThread(start_address = RWX buffer) -> WaitForSingleObject(handle, 5000) -> CloseHandle
injection_details.target_process: Its own process (self-injection); GetCurrentProcess() is called at 0x14000188B for the pseudo-handle, no remote process is opened
injection_details.target_discovery: None - no process enumeration; the current process is used. NtOpenProcess / NtQueueApcThread / NtWriteVirtualMemory syscall numbers are resolved (suggesting remote APC injection capability) but are never invoked in this build
injection_details.payload_source: 64-byte RC4-encrypted blob embedded in .data at 0x140003000, decrypted on the stack with key 'H3llsG@t3_Sysc@l' inside WinMain (0x1400019BC) then passed to the executor at 0x14000188B
injection_details.payload_write: Plain memcpy (msvcrt) into the locally allocated RWX region - no WriteProcessMemory/NtWriteVirtualMemory call
injection_details.execution_trigger: kernel32!CreateThread on the RWX allocation (thread start address = shellcode base)
injection_details.direct_syscall_status: The syscall invoker stub at 0x1400017C9 is a non-functional placeholder that always returns 0xC0000001 (STATUS_UNSUCCESSFUL); the SSNs are collected but execution actually proceeds through Win32 APIs (VirtualAlloc/CreateThread)
